faq_heading: Langley houses under $1.2 million: your questions answered

faq.q: How many Langley houses sell for under $1,200,000?
faq.a: 210 of 777, or 27%. 121 of them sold between $1,000,000 and $1,199,999.

faq.q: How much more does $1,200,000 buy than $1,000,000 in Langley?
faq.a: 121 more sales, 16% of the market. The share under the cap rises from 11% to 27%.

faq.q: Which Langley areas have house medians near $1,200,000?
faq.a: Murrayville ($1,487,250, 50 sales) to Campbell Valley ($2,565,000, 9 sales) are the 4 closest, for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Is $1,200,000 enough for a house in Langley?
faq.a: The median was $1,378,000, so $1,200,000 is 13% below it, and 27% of 777 sales closed under it.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are Paragon closed and pending sales to October 31, 2026. A pending sale is firm but has not completed, so its price can still change. A median is shown only where at least 5 homes sold. The live search is not connected yet (Jerry’s saved search, price filter $1,200,000).

In Langley, 210 of the 777 houses (27%) sold under $1,200,000: 89 for less than $1,000,000 and 121 more between $1,000,000 and $1,199,999. The busiest price range, $1,200,000 to $1,499,999, had 297 sales.

The lower quarter of Langley houses sold at $1,175,000 or less, $25,000 under $1,200,000, and the upper quarter at $1,600,000 or more, $400,000 above it. A house at the cap would sit below the median.

blocks.text: Buying a house under $1,200,000 in Langley

The Langley median house was $1,378,000, so $1,200,000 sits 13% below it. Murrayville: $577 a square foot, built 1993, 50 sales. Salmon River: $602 a square foot, built 1982, 28 sales. Fort Langley: $621 a square foot, built 1979, 31 sales. Campbell Valley: $550 a square foot, built 2018, 9 sales. Check the roof age and foundation.
